content: Do you think that climate change is responsible for the recent floods?
It could be. There are floods in this country almost every year, but in recent years they have been more widespread and more frequent.
It seems that the climate in this country is changing.
The summers are hotter. The last three summers have been the hottest for the past 200 years. There have also been stronger winds.
I think that the changing climate is a sign that we are causing too much damage to the environment.
I think you're right. Climate change naturally over time, but I think that human activities are speeding up the change. I wish that government would join together and try to resolve the problem.
Me too. If we don't do something soon, It might be too late.
